# BDR Appoints Ryan Farris CEO as Founder Bruce Wiseman Becomes Executive Chairman
July 14, 2026
Ryan Farris
[**Business Development Resources**](https://www.bdrco.com/) (BDR) has appointed **Ryan Farris** as chief executive officer, marking a leadership transition at the business coaching and training firm serving home service contractors across North America.
Founder **Bruce Wiseman** will remain with the company as executive chairman.
Farris assumes the CEO role effective immediately, bringing more than 30 years of leadership experience across entrepreneurship, technology, marketing and business operations.
